clips.title: The story
paras: In Ironforge's Commons, citizens and Alliance travelers bring their wealth to the Vault. It is the city's primary bank and treasure house, overseen by Dinita and the Stonemantle family.

You find the Vault in the Commons, where travelers, soldiers, and merchants bring coin, relics, and provisions for safekeeping. City guards and tellers watch over its work. Dinita and the Stonemantle family oversee the bank, where citizens and Alliance visitors keep their wealth secure.
